development_context: The previous additive candidate remains stopped. This experiment changes supervision alignment while retaining the original features and fixed thresholds.
observed_code_issue: The existing development surrogate pools outputs from other outer-fold classifiers of the same configuration, whereas evaluation targets one particular outer-fold five-seed ensemble. This is a recipe-level projection; it is not necessarily a surrogate of that exact fitted ensemble. Existing descriptions remain statistical, not automatically invalid.
hypothesis: Match the surrogate training target to the exact frozen five-seed ensemble used at evaluation; hold other design choices fixed.
inputs: 729 baseline pool; original650 development participants and5184 configuration rows; original290 frozen checkpoints and calibration/preprocessing artifacts.
training_population: For each configuration/target domain, exactly the participants in the old development rows of that configuration outside that domain. No additional surrogate training participants.
reference_preprocessing: Fit four original concept transforms and original monotone reference once on baseline participants outside the target domain, apply identically to surrogate training and target rows. No test-domain features/labels used to fit these transformations. Original frozen membership verifies test-domain participants absent from teacher training/calibration.
teacher_replay: Apply the original target-domain checkpoints and Platt transforms to baseline rows, averaging5 seed probabilities then clipping to[1e-4,1-1e-4] and taking logit. No classifier training or recalibration. Preserve actual acquisition domain in a separate field; inference routing outer_domain denotes the checkpoint group only.

methods.HISTORICAL_AD4: Immutable previous linear development predictions from additive experiment, same participants and configuration keys.
methods.MIXED_AD4: Common outer-excluded feature transforms, old mixed outer-fold logit targets, StandardScaler+Ridge(alpha1).
methods.MATCHED_AD4: Same people and common four features as MIXED_AD4, targets generated by exact target ensemble; StandardScaler+Ridge(alpha1).
methods.MATCHED_REF1: Same people and exact target ensemble targets, common scalar reference logit; StandardScaler+Ridge(alpha1).

parameter_selection: None; no grid, new features, candidate reselection or test-dependent thresholds.
primary: Equal participant-weight MAE after averaging configuration losses within participant on all650 source development people.
continuation_gate: All three contrasts must have >=10% relative MAE reduction,95% paired-participant interval lower>0,and>=7/9 configuration directions. Same practical development scale as prior candidate, not a clinical effect threshold.
teacher_replay_gate: Replayed test probabilities match saved original probabilities to1e-6 for every5184 development row; all seed counts5; no target participants in frozen teacher train/calibration pool.
second_stage: Only if source gate passes, apply saved source-only fits to existing402 natural scan pairs, comparing change MAE against prior AD4 and matched scalar with same10%/7-of9/positive-interval gates. No further fits. Reused cohort remains exploratory.
stop_rule: If source gate fails, do not evaluate confirmation or scan pairs for this candidate. Do not retune it to recover a pass.
interpretation: Tests consistency of a behavior surrogate with its target fitted classifier. No error-triage, clinical, causal or reader benefit inferred. Historical evaluation participants/results have already been examined; this is exploratory method development despite formal split exclusion.
preservation: Write only new protocol/script/output; no changes to original teacher artifacts or previous gates/results.
